name: material-ollama
description: Repository-root verification gates for the shared user-facing feature inventory and the hand-written local-suite inventory. This package intentionally declares no dependencies: every `verify*`/`progress` script runs a plain Node.js checker (scripts/check-uh-inventory.mjs or scripts/check-suite-inventory.mjs) directly.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:inventory && npm run verify:suites && npm run verify:design
